purpose: Native Stagewise reference continuation; passing named cases does not establish full parity.
sourceState: Reviewed working tree on developmentBase; canonical source hashes below identify the tested changes. Publication manifest records the eventual committed source.

tests.skipExplanation: Offscreen transcript link suite skips the real browser-tab case; native_transcript_tabs_real executes and passes that exact case on the Windows platform.

resolvedFindings: Fullscreen host found the browser viewport parent instead of the containing tab; ancestor lookup restores entry and preserves hidden chrome on resize.
Headless/provider validation advertised an interactive question tool. Explicit host opt-in now gates advertisement and dispatch; four provider protocols cover unexpected questions without blocking.

Initially empty and pre-measure scroll area hints starved question controls. Dynamic layout sizing fixes main/side forms, bounded compact scrolling and queue visibility; light/dark content backgrounds checked.

Command-center fixture processed queued dialog deactivation after activating its shortcut target. Settling prior events first fixes the gate; null checks prevent a secondary fixture crash. Actual shell open/reuse/close/reopen remains asserted. Stale-root fixture waits for its query, acquires a bounded DELETE readiness handle, then performs one same-handle rename and verifies stale result rejection.
Browser fullscreen fixture incorrectly stole WebView focus back to the parent HWND. Foreground activation now precedes actual WebView focus; strict policy gates retained.

Windows QSaveFile fixture replacement conflicted with an open reader even with delete sharing. Measured single ReplaceFileW replacement and positive/negative sharing/churn cases fix the fixture; production Git watcher unchanged.

representativeRenders.scope: Actual MainWindow fixture; light/dark at1100/350 pixels, question/queue geometry and content-background assertions. Inspected local images are intentionally not exported with source. Not a complete paired screenshot sweep.

limits: Local synthetic/loopback tests on the installed Windows toolchain; no new paid/live-provider validation or complete paired upstream runtime sweep.
Source preservation is verified separately; all701 features remain in scope. Full native visual/behavior parity and identical model reasoning/output are not claimed.

Remaining multi-workspace mounts, sandbox API adapters, transcript retry/edit/revert, automatic compression accounting, provider/subscription/plugin OAuth, full media/session restoration, ACP/research and distribution gaps are in the readiness map.
Ready build is an internal test bundle, unsigned; requires installed WebView2 runtime, Git and PowerShell for the related features.
Shell/watchers are process-local and retain user OS permissions; failed queue writes are only retried in memory.
